metadata.title: A flat geodesic with a periodic asymptote
metadata.abstract: We construct a closed surface of genus $2$ with nonpositive Gaussian curvature and a complete nonperiodic flat geodesic asymptotic to a flat closed geodesic. The metric is of class $C^{3,1/3}$ and its curvature is of class $C^{1,1/3}$, but not $C^2$. Thus the periodic-asymptote obstruction for smooth surfaces does not extend to $C^1$ Gaussian curvature.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 在属数二闭曲面上构造非正高斯曲率度量，具有一条非周期的完全平坦测地线，渐近于平坦闭测地线。
techniques: 平坦测地线的渐近行为
analysis.breakthrough: 构造达到度量 C³,¹ᐟ³、曲率 C¹,¹ᐟ³，说明光滑曲面的周期渐近障碍不能直接推广到 C¹ 曲率。
analysis.limitations: 曲率不是 C²，不能将该反例称为光滑度量反例，也不否定已有光滑情形的障碍定理。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 准确定位几何动力学结论的正则性边界。
